snippet.title: Wolf With Inn | Announcement Cozy Game Trailer
snippet.description:
🐺 Wishlist Wolf with Inn on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3902280/Wolf_with_Inn/ 

Wolf With Inn is a cozy fantasy tavern indie game for those tired of being the hero. You are a wolf with your own inn. Mushroom folk live across the river, and noble white knights want you catched. Dare to don the wolf's skin? Wishlist!
